AULA S20 Programmable Wired Gaming Mouse - Black (2400 DPI)

Enhance your desktop performance and enjoy seamless gameplay control with the AULA S20 Programmable Wired Gaming Mouse in Black. Available at Turbo Computer, this sleek and reliable peripheral is designed for gamers and office professionals who value ergonomic comfort, responsive tracking, and custom macro executions without any input latency. Finished in a premium black shell, it serves as an excellent budget-friendly upgrade for your gaming rig or workstation layout across Egypt.

The AULA S20 features a highly accurate optical tracking sensor supporting four adjustable DPI levels (800 / 1200 / 1600 / 2400 DPI) to match your workflow or sensitivity preferences instantly. Packed with a dynamic 4-color breathing LED system (Blue, Pink, Purple, Red), it lets you synchronize or toggle the light effects via software programming. With its full macro button configuration and robust braided cable, this mouse guarantees consistent, durable everyday usage.
